title: A worker's brief gives it its session id for the Session trailer (second-project run)
goal: dispatch names the worker's session id (or the way to read it) in the brief, so the worker's commits carry the Session trailer the role file lists

run:
import re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
ids = [p.stem for p in sorted(Path("kb/_self/backlog").glob("ST-*.json")) if p.stem != "ST-hlpvqc2h"]
for iid in ids[:5]:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "brief", iid], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
    if p.returncode == 0 and "## Fixed rules" in p.stdout:
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit("no brief could be composed")
rules = p.stdout.split("## Fixed rules", 1)[1].split("\n## ", 1)[0]
assert re.search(r"session[ _-]?id|Session:", rules, re.I), "fixed rules of the brief name no session id"

notes: Run finding 20: the worker reported no Session: trailer, since my brief gave no session id; its commit carried Co-Authored-By, Self-Reviewed and KB-Work only. SP-djl7za6x close: ST-gtaw5kip's worker reported its commit lacks the Session trailer the role file lists, since its brief gave no value (kb's own clone, not only a second project).
